equations.label: SP-125 Eq. 4-6
equations.quote: chamber walls excluding injector face can be approximated by the following expression
equations.description: Total chamber wall surface area excluding the injector face: cylinder plus conical convergent section.
assumptions: Approximation of the total surface area of the combustion-chamber walls, excluding the injector face (PDF p.98)

carry_forward.reason: Restated from PDF p.98. The legacy 'cylindrical chamber with straight convergent cone' is implied by the expression but not stated in words on the page, so it is not carried as a source assumption. MODEL_CHAMBER_SHOULDER_FILL_FRACTION (Rs = 0.8 Rs,max, a repository geometry heuristic) does not implement this equation; the legacy link was model-driven extraction context, not an implementation claim, so it is not carried.

equations.label: SP-125 Eq. 4-7
equations.quote: The length of the conical nozzle section can be expressed by the equation
equations.description: Length of the conical nozzle section (throat arc radius R, divergent half angle alpha).
assumptions: Conical nozzle whose throat section has the contour of a circular arc (PDF p.98, Fig. 4-10)
validity: Typical-design range stated for the conical nozzle, not a stated validity limit of Eq. (4-7): throat arc radius R = 0.5 to 1.5 R_t (PDF p.98)
Typical-design range stated for the conical nozzle, not a stated validity limit of Eq. (4-7): convergent cone half angle 20 to 45 deg (PDF p.98)
Typical-design range stated for the conical nozzle, not a stated validity limit of Eq. (4-7): divergent cone half angle approximately 12 to 18 deg (PDF p.99)

carry_forward.reason: Restated from PDF pp.98-99 with the qualification that the ranges describe typical conical-nozzle designs, not limits of the geometric relation.
